title: Surface roughness of turned shafts
intro: Fifteen shafts were turned on a lathe at five feed rates (0.10 to 0.30 mm per revolution) and three cutting speeds (100, 175 and 250 m/min), and the surface roughness Ra (µm) was measured. The model is Roughness = b₀ + b₁·Feed + b₂·Cutting speed. Each coefficient is the change in Ra for one unit more of its predictor with the other held fixed; the line for Feed is also shown as numbers.
